documented_probe: C-5ede2c22 (preserve the reference model file and simulate with a fresh MuJoCo installation without plugins; min difficulty medium): the box ships without MuJoCo and with a pinned offline wheelhouse; the agent must pip-install mujoco==3.2.4 with --no-index, tune a slider feed-stage model into a second self-contained file (no plugins/assets/includes, one joint + one actuator, zero loaded plugins), keep the reference byte-identical to the pristine copy, and survive the acceptance sweep (tuned > 0.35 m, reference < 0.10 m at 2 s) on the visible drive and on hidden positive/negative drive sets.
notes: Medium: three dependent stages (offline install, model tuning, proof-of-run), an immutability constraint on the reference fixture, self-containment traps (plugins/assets/includes rejected by scan and by mjModel.nplugin), and hidden generalization over drive values. No resource pressure; simulation is deterministic and fast.
